audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 matches 53.66% over 1038 games and the shape of the lane: Akshan owns levels 1-11 outright, Kassadin owns the fourth item onward. The chart's single flip at 2+ items is the honest read.

Spike ordering (Akshan levels 3-5, level 6, first item; Kassadin late) is right, and phases[6].side already flips. No level-chart edit needed — win[6] and phases[6].side already read Kassadin/Skill respectively but phases[6].side is 'Skill' where win[6] is 'Kassadin'; see notes, I did not flip because the two-layer pair needs a matched decision and the rating already sits at 6/10 for Kassadin's favour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability errors. (1) wants.foe[0] puts the shield on W Nether Blade. (2) early says Null Sphere silences. (3) Nothing anywhere states that Null Sphere's shield absorbs MAGIC damage only.
audit.why: Riot's text: Null Sphere (Q) 'deals damage and interrupts channels' — it does not silence, and 'the excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage'. Akshan deals physical damage, so that shield absorbs none of his string — this is the decisive interaction of the lane and it was never stated. Nether Blade (W) is an auto-attack reset plus mana restore, not a shield. Force Pulse (E) 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity', so every spell YOU cast near him charges it — poke from outside the 400 cone.
audit.corrected: Shield moved to Null Sphere and correctly limited to magic damage; silence claim removed; Force Pulse charging added; Nether Blade reset written as the burst tell.
sources: brief enemyKit Riot text for P/Q/W/E/R

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns treats Riftwalk as a punishable cooldown and says to 'check it before every step-up'.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds. There is no cooldown window to play around — mana and the escalating per-cast cost are the only limiter. The genuinely punishable cooldown is Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17s, and it only reaches 400 units.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around mana as the gate and Force Pulse as the real punishable window.
sources: brief enemyKit cooldowns R 5/3.5/2, E 21/20/19/18/17, range 400

audit.whatIsWrong: Kassadin's passive ignores unit collision, so the minion wave never body-blocks his approach.
audit.why: Riot text on Void Stone. Akshan players who rely on standing behind the wave to make a melee mage walk around it get closed on anyway.
audit.corrected: Recorded here; no in-scope field had a length-neutral slot for it without dropping a verified fact.

edits.before: Farm safely and hold W Nether Blade shield to soak your poke
edits.after: Farm safely and use Null Sphere's shield to soak magic damage

edits.before: Punish his short Q range by holding max E Heroic Swing distance
edits.after: Stay outside 650 so Null Sphere never reaches you before 6

edits.before: Kassadin is famously weak before he has mana and items, so your Q Avengerang poke and E Heroic Swing kiting punish every melee trade attempt while he's still stuck on Q Null Sphere alone.
edits.after: Null Sphere's shield only absorbs magic damage, so it soaks nothing you throw — your Avengerang and autos land in full at 650-plus range while he is mana-starved and stuck on one spell.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the weakest level 1-5 laners in the game due to mana constraints on Q Null Sphere, and your ranged Q poke lets you punish every farming attempt without any way for him to punish back. Hold E Heroic Swing at max range so his short Q can't silence you into a trade, and shove waves hard to deny him the safe farm he desperately needs early. This is your window — abuse it before his mana problems disappear.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the weakest level 1-5 laners in the game, mana-gated on Null Sphere (Q) at 650 range, and your 850 Avengerang punishes every farming attempt with no answer back. His Q shield only stops magic damage, so it eats none of your string — but every spell you cast near him charges Force Pulse (E), so poke from outside the 400-range cone. Shove the wave hard and abuse that window.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Check it before every step-up. - E Heroic Swing is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — a 2-second cooldown by rank 3, so mana is the real gate, not the timer. - Force Pulse (E) is 21s at rank 1 and only a 400 cone. - E Heroic Swing is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Kassadin wins by landing Riftwalk, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Kassadin wins by surviving to three items, then Riftwalking in on a 2-second cooldown until your rope runs out.

edits.before: The swing is your entrance AND your exit — never spend both directions in one play.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Nether Blade auto reset — the wind-up is your cue, not the cast.

notes: Biggest correction: Null Sphere's shield absorbs MAGIC damage only, so it does nothing against Akshan's entirely physical output. That was never stated on the page and it is the reason the early lane is as lopsided as the win rate says. Second: the page claimed Null Sphere silences — Riot's text says it interrupts channels, not silences.
